env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

# logos next --fix saves each filesystem replace target in memory. A target
# with more than 20000 files or more than 64 MiB of file bytes is refused
# before the files past the cap are read, and nothing is changed.
cd gen
go build -o $WORK/mktree$GOEXE .
cd ../m
cp go.mod $WORK/go.mod.orig
cp a.go $WORK/a.orig

# 2 module files plus 19999 generated files: one file over the cap.
mkdir ../many
cp ../depmod/go.mod ../many/go.mod
cp ../depmod/dep.go ../many/dep.go
exec $WORK/mktree$GOEXE ../many files 19999
cp ../extra/go.mod.many go.mod
! logos next --fix
! stdout '.'
stderr 'local replacement example.com/nextcap/dep: \.\./many: too large to freeze: more than 20000 files'
cmp a.go $WORK/a.orig
! exists a.lgo
! exists next_tasks.json

# Two sparse files of 32 MiB + 1 and 32 MiB: each is under the cap, their
# sum is one byte over it. The second file is unreadable, so a refusal that
# names the byte cap shows that it was refused before it was opened.
mkdir ../big
cp ../depmod/go.mod ../big/go.mod
cp ../depmod/dep.go ../big/dep.go
exec $WORK/mktree$GOEXE ../big sparse 33554433 33554432
cp ../extra/go.mod.big go.mod
! logos next --fix
! stdout '.'
stderr 'local replacement example.com/nextcap/dep: \.\./big: too large to freeze: more than 67108864 bytes'
[!root] ! stderr 'permission denied'
cmp a.go $WORK/a.orig
! exists a.lgo
! exists next_tasks.json

# Under both caps the same target converts.
rm ../big/a.bin ../big/b.bin
logos next --fix
stdout '^\+\+\+ b/a\.lgo$'
cmp go.mod ../extra/go.mod.big
cmp a.go $WORK/a.orig
! exists a.lgo

-- gen/go.mod --
module example.com/mktree

go 1.27
-- gen/main.go --
// mktree makes a replace target past one snapshot cap: "files N" writes N
// empty files, "sparse A B" writes a sparse file a.bin of A bytes and an
// unreadable sparse file b.bin of B bytes.
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"log"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"strconv"
)

func main() {
	dir := os.Args[1]
	switch os.Args[2] {
	case "files":
		n, err := strconv.Atoi(os.Args[3])
		if err != nil {
			log.Fatal(err)
		}
		for i := range n {
			if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(dir, fmt.Sprintf("f%05d.txt", i)), nil, 0o644); err != nil {
				log.Fatal(err)
			}
		}
	case "sparse":
		for i, name := range []string{"a.bin", "b.bin"} {
			size, err := strconv.ParseInt(os.Args[3+i], 10, 64)
			if err != nil {
				log.Fatal(err)
			}
			path := filepath.Join(dir, name)
			if err := os.WriteFile(path, nil, 0o644); err != nil {
				log.Fatal(err)
			}
			if err := os.Truncate(path, size); err != nil {
				log.Fatal(err)
			}
		}
		if err := os.Chmod(filepath.Join(dir, "b.bin"), 0); err != nil {
			log.Fatal(err)
		}
	default:
		log.Fatalf("unknown mode %q", os.Args[2])
	}
}
-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/nextcap

go 1.27
-- m/a.go --
package sample

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/nextcap/dep"
)

func Label(n int) string {
	dep.Ping()
	return fmt.Sprintf("n=%d", n)
}
-- extra/go.mod.many --
module example.com/nextcap

go 1.27

require example.com/nextcap/dep v0.0.0

replace example.com/nextcap/dep => ../many
-- extra/go.mod.big --
module example.com/nextcap

go 1.27

require example.com/nextcap/dep v0.0.0

replace example.com/nextcap/dep => ../big
-- depmod/go.mod --
module example.com/nextcap/dep

go 1.27
-- depmod/dep.go --
package dep

func Ping() {}
